title: Teething and Dental Chew Toy Set for Puppies
short: A mixed pack of rope, rubber and chew toys for small dogs. Sold in 3, 6 or 9 pieces with random styles.
why: Variety helps you see which textures your puppy prefers. Watch for loose threads on rope toys.
